name: Brightstar Fist
description: Punch with a fist that burns white at the knuckles and sears where it lands.

name: Brightstar Guard
description: Hold up a white shell of starlight that glares in the foe's eyes and takes the blow.

name: Brightstar Step
description: Step forward on a bright trail that blinds anyone who looks along it.

name: Brightstar Turn
description: Throw a flash from the forearm as a blow arrives and turn it in the glare.

name: Brightstar Sight
description: Pour white starlight across the field and see every shape that falls in shadow.

name: Brightstar Pierce
description: Throw a narrow white needle of starlight through the guard and the arm behind it.

name: Brightstar Mend
description: Pour a clean white warmth into a wound and close it in yourself or an ally.

name: Brightstar Cleanse
description: Burn a taint clean from the blood with a white wash of light in yourself or an ally.

name: Brightstar Volley
description: Loose white bolts of starlight that all strike the one spot together.

name: Brightstar Cover
description: Spread a white cover of starlight over yourself and your allies that burns off heavy blows.

name: Brightstar Judgment
description: Pass a white judgment across the field that scorches every foe it touches.

name: Starbright Lance
description: streams: Celestial + Light; gather the star and the light into one white lance and run it through everything in the line.

name: Starfold Fist
description: Punch through a fold of space so the fist arrives inside the guard.

name: Starfold Guard
description: Fold a layer of starlit space before the body so a blow strikes only the fold.

name: Starfold Step
description: Fold the ground under the stride so one step carries the body three paces.

name: Starfold Turn
description: Fold a strike's path aside so it passes through the space beside the body.

name: Starfold Sight
description: Fold the field into a small chart and read every foe at once from it.

name: Starfold Pierce
description: Open a fold behind the guard and drive a point of starlight out through it.

name: Starfold Mend
description: Fold the lips of a wound together in starlit space until they hold in yourself or an ally.

name: Starfold Cleanse
description: Fold a taint out of the body into the starlit space beyond it for yourself or an ally.

name: Starfold Volley
description: Loose bolts through a fold so they leave the sky behind the foe and strike from there.

name: Starfold Cover
description: Fold a cover of space and starlight over yourself and your allies that eats heavy blows.

name: Starfold Sweep
description: Sweep a folded edge of starlit space across the field and cut every foe along it.

name: Starfold Leap
description: Fold the whole field behind you and cross it in a single bright leap.

name: Folded Constellation
description: streams: Celestial + Space; fold distant stars into the field so their weight and light fall on every foe at once.
